title: Trim Leading Rows With Too Few Observed Values by ID — TrimInitialRowsByID
text: function removes leading rows within ID first retained row least min_nonmissing non-missing observed variables. useful creating elapsed-time variable leading records contain usable measurements. Unlike DeleteInitialNA(), default require first retained row complete selected variables.
